title: Working with APIs in Flutter
body: Most real-world Flutter applications need to communicate with backend services. This guide covers HTTP requests using http package, JSON parsing, error handling, loading states, and best practices for API integration. Learn how to structure your API calls and handle different response scenarios.

title: Flutter Testing Strategies
body: Testing is crucial for maintaining code quality and preventing regressions. This article covers unit testing, widget testing, and integration testing in Flutter. Learn how to write effective tests, mock dependencies, test user interactions, and set up continuous integration for your Flutter projects.

title: Performance Optimization in Flutter
body: Performance is key to providing a smooth user experience. This guide covers Flutter performance optimization techniques including widget rebuilding optimization, image optimization, memory management, and profiling tools. Learn how to identify performance bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve your app's performance.

title: Flutter App Deployment and Publishing
body: Once your Flutter app is ready, you need to deploy it to app stores. This article covers the complete deployment process for both Android and iOS platforms, including app signing, build configuration, store listing requirements, and submission procedures. Learn how to prepare your app for production release.

title: Advanced Flutter Widgets and Customization
body: Flutter provides a rich set of widgets, but sometimes you need custom solutions. This article explores advanced widget concepts including custom painters, custom render objects, gesture handling, and animation controllers. Learn how to create unique user experiences and extend Flutter's widget system.

title: Flutter for Web and Desktop
body: Flutter's multi-platform capabilities extend beyond mobile. This guide covers Flutter web and desktop development, including platform-specific considerations, responsive design for web, desktop window management, and deployment strategies. Learn how to leverage Flutter's universal nature to reach more users.
